question: 3 solid spheres of diameters 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm are melted together to form a single solid sphere. Find its radius.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For melting **n** spheres into one, the large radius **R** follows: R³ = r₁³ + r₂³ + ... + rₙ³.

Given diameters are 6, 8, 10 cm, so radii are 3, 4, 5 cm.

R³ = 3³ + 4³ + 5³ = 27 + 64 + 125 = 216

R = √³216 = 6 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameters of three spheres: D₁ = 6 cm, D₂ = 8 cm, D₃ = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **solid sphere** = (4/3) × π × r³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72027ab8622a5e64c90161cf914c8cb5db3d88882b3bb65029f7cd056752b33c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius of 1st sphere (r₁) = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm

⇒ Radius of 2ⁿd sphere (r₂) = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 cm

⇒ Radius of 3rd sphere (r₃) = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm

⇒ Total volume of new sphere = Volume₁ + Volume₂ + Volume₃

⇒ (4/3) × π × R³ = (4/3) × π × (r₁³ + r₂³ + r₃³)

⇒ R³ = 3³ + 4³ + 5³

⇒ R³ = 27 + 64 + 125 = 216

⇒ R = √³216 = 6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by 4 × π × r².

Volume of Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half a sphere, so its volume is (2/3) × π × r³.

Recasting Principle

Whenever a solid object is **melted and recast** into another shape, the **total volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage.

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere

The CSA of a hemisphere is 2 × π × r² and the Total Surface Area (TSA) is 3 × π × r².</p
